presets.label: Keep the pitch order, change the rhythm
Keep the melody, change the accompaniment
Keep the bass, change the upper voices
Keep the contour, change interval sizes

operations.name: Rhythm reshape
operations.whatItChanges: changes when notes start and how long they last

footnotes.text: Melody pitches stay; its rhythm changes, so Keep melody and Keep rhythm cannot both be on.

operations.name: Articulation
operations.whatItChanges: changes how long notes sound

operations.name: Density and rests
operations.whatItChanges: changes how many notes there are and where the rests fall

operations.name: Accent shift
operations.whatItChanges: changes which notes are accented

operations.name: Melodic sequence
operations.whatItChanges: repeats the motif at another pitch level

footnotes.text: Diatonic sequences keep interval sizes in scale steps, not semitones.

operations.name: Accompaniment pattern
operations.whatItChanges: changes how the chords are played

operations.name: Bass pattern
operations.whatItChanges: changes the bass line

operations.name: Voicing and register
operations.whatItChanges: changes how the chords are voiced and where they sit

footnotes.text: Melody pitch classes stay; its octave may change.
Only spacing, register of upper voices and hand distribution change; inversions are off while Keep bass is on.

operations.name: Simplify
operations.whatItChanges: plays fewer, easier notes

operations.name: Interval reshape
operations.whatItChanges: changes the size of the melody's intervals

operations.name: Change direction
operations.whatItChanges: turns the melody's movement upside down

operations.name: Passing and neighbour notes
operations.whatItChanges: adds notes between the main notes

operations.name: Ornament
operations.whatItChanges: adds quick neighbour notes to the long melody notes

operations.name: Reharmonise
operations.whatItChanges: changes the chords under the melody

operations.name: Изменение ритма
